scope: Same-host TCP. All native cells run five times; every sample retained. Diagnostic captures use separate short budgets and never enter timing results.
goal: portable pooled p50 <= min(current legacy,fixed C++), and positive reads/writes plus attempts <= C++ independently per process capture.
statistics: mean_ns is the pooled arithmetic mean; displayed ± run SD is sample SD (n-1) across five run means, not a confidence interval. Sample SD and extrema are retained separately.

incomplete_integration.reason: SharedPayload-only integration missed the measured PlainParams/PlainResults paths. All six profile processes increased instructions 0.00-0.03%; no native campaign run. The core cache is retained for a complete integration candidate.

validation.check: Selected-reader ownership, bounds and budget regressions
validation.detail: 16 native tests and all 16 under Miri, including two new owning-cache regressions.
Core no-default-features and alloc-only; wire no-default-features.

validation.check: Strict workspace Clippy and unsafe documentation gate
validation.detail: All targets. Exception counts unchanged; reviewed hashes refreshed for message.rs and arena.rs.
Root format and exact source patch replay; frozen binary source files remain identical.
Asserted the list nesting error for a struct; corrected to the existing struct error. All regression tests then passed.
Build-cache cleanup removed a proc-macro dependency during Clippy. Rebuilt and reran; subsequent cleanup occurred only after builds finished.
Source edits changed two recorded hashes, with identical diagnostic counts. Reviewed and refreshed only those hashes; gate then passed.

580,000 native samples independently verified, including five-run means/spreads/percentiles, budgets, order and executable hashes; 240 compatibility checks; 48 original wire pairs and 228 directed topology edges match received frames.
Repository check, 104 project documents and workflow dependency checks pass; report-relative links checked separately.

validation.check: Full coverage and full C++ correctness suites
validation.detail: Targeted ownership/protocol checks and fixed C++ benchmark compatibility exercised; no coverage claim.

confirmation.scope: Separate five-run follow-up to full-matrix regressions. All 100,000 samples retained; does not replace or pool with the main matrix.

archive.count_scope: Logical bytes including hard links, excluding SHA256SUMS itself.
